addr: 307/14, Diamond Arcade, 9th Main, 39th A Cross Rd, 5th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560041, India

rev.t: Visited Smoor recently and really enjoyed the Belgian Classic Dark Hot Chocolate—it was rich, delicious, and definitely the highlight, though a bit pricey. The Mango Classic Cheesecake Pastry and Eggless Choco Truffle Pastry were both tasty …

Tried the chocolate croissant and dark chocolate brownie. Both were delicious and perfect for chocolate lovers. The croissant was flaky with a nice chocolate filling, while the brownie was rich, soft, and full of chocolate flavour. Overall, a satisfying dessert experience and definitely worth trying! 🍫🥐✨ …

I heard lot about fine eateries in Jayanagar and wanted to try the smoor here. The vibe is quite nice and food options were also fine. Alfredo pasta is very tasty and signature cold coffee is one of the best beverages to have. I found the French fries here very good and crunchy. Good place to buy chocolates and desserts.
